notice_text: Request for Proposals Information Systems  (Single Stage-Two Envelope Process) Purchaser: National Information Technology Authority-Uganda Name of Project: Uganda Digital Acceleration Project (UDAP) Project ID: P171305             Credit No.: 6898-UG            Country: Uganda Contract Title :   Design, Development and Deployment of the Digital Solution for Equitable Health Care Among Refugee Communities Reference No.: NITA-U/UDAP/SUPLS/2026-2027/00026 Issued on: 16th October, 2026                                        1.The Government of Uganda represented by the National Information Technology Authority Uganda (NITA-U)  has received  financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the:  Uganda Digital Acceleration Project-Government Network (UDAP-GOVNET) , and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for  Design, Development and Deployment of the Digital Solution for Equitable Health Care among Refugee Communities.   .   2.National Information Technology Authority-Uganda (NITA-U)  now invites sealed Bids from eligible Proposers for Design, Development and Deployment of the Digital Solution for Equitable Health Care among Refugee Communities . 3. The procurement process will be conducted through International competitive procurement using Request for Proposals (RFP) as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers - Procurement in Investment Projects Financing” (July 2016, revised February 2025) and is open to all eligible proposers as defined in the Procurement Regulations. 4. Interested eligible Proposers may obtain further information from National Information Technology Authority-Uganda   and inspect the request for proposal document during office hours  0800  to  1700  hours from Monday to Friday at the address given below. 5.A pre-proposal meeting will be held  3rd November, 2026  at  NITA-U Head Office, Palm Courts, Plot 7A, Rotary Avenue  at  1100 Hours East Africa Time  with an Online Virtual Meeting .A link will be shared with all registered proposers prior to the date of the meeting. The proposers who wish to attend the meeting shall register and submit their official email addresses not later than one (1) day to the date of the meeting to jacqueline.musimenta@nita.go.ug . 6.The request for proposal document in English may be purchased by interested eligible Proposers upon the submission of a written application to the address below and upon payment of a nonrefundable fee of  Ugx.200,000 (Two Hundred Thousand Uganda Shillings Only) or equivalent in a freely convertible currency . The method of payment will be the  Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT)  Bank account number:  006550058000001 ,  Customer name : National Information Technology Authority, Uganda (NITA-U),  Account title : NITA-U Local Revenue Expenditure Account,  Bank Name : Bank of Uganda Swift Code:  UGBAUGKA . A PDF bidding document shall be sent to the potential bidder electronically upon receipt of confirmation of payment. 7.Proposals must be delivered to the address below on or before  30th November, 2026  at  1100 Hours East Africa Time  Electronic procurement  will not  be permitted. Late Proposals will be rejected. Proposals will be publicly opened in the presence of the Proposers’ designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend, at the address below on  1st   Floor Boardroom ,  1105 Hours East Africa Time 30th November, 2026 .  All envelopes marked “FINANCIAL PART” shall remain unopened and will be held in safe custody of the Purchaser until the second public Proposals opening.  8.Proposals must be accompanied by a  Proposal Security   of  ;   UGX 120,000,000/= (Uganda Shillings, One Hundred and Twenty Million) or an equivalent amount in a freely convertible currency.   The Proposal Security shall be valid in accordance with Section II-Proposal Data Sheet (PDS); ITP 20.1 9.Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful proposer’s beneficial ownership, as part of the   Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the proposal document. 10.The address referred to above is:     The Procurement Specialist     National Information Technology Authority-Uganda     Plot 7A, Palm Courts, Rotary Avenue,1st Floor Room 1     Kampala-Uganda

Request for Proposals Information Systems

 (Single Stage-Two Envelope Process)

Purchaser: National Information Technology Authority-Uganda

Name of Project: Uganda Digital Acceleration Project (UDAP)

Project ID: P171305             Credit No.: 6898-UG            Country: Uganda

Contract Title:  Design, Development and Deployment of the Digital Solution for Equitable Health Care Among Refugee Communities

Reference No.: NITA-U/UDAP/SUPLS/2026-2027/00026

Issued on: 16th October, 2026                                       

1.The Government of Uganda represented by the National Information Technology Authority Uganda (NITA-U) has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the: Uganda Digital Acceleration Project-Government Network (UDAP-GOVNET), and intends to apply part of the proceeds toward payments under the contract for Design, Development and Deployment of the Digital Solution for Equitable Health Care among Refugee Communities.  .
 

2.National Information Technology Authority-Uganda (NITA-U) now invites sealed Bids from eligible Proposers for Design, Development and Deployment of the Digital Solution for Equitable Health Care among Refugee Communities.

3. The procurement process will be conducted through International competitive procurement using Request for Proposals (RFP) as specified in the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers - Procurement in Investment Projects Financing” (July 2016, revised February 2025) and is open to all eligible proposers as defined in the Procurement Regulations.

4. Interested eligible Proposers may obtain further information from National Information Technology Authority-Uganda and inspect the request for proposal document during office hours 0800 to 1700 hours from Monday to Friday at the address given below.

5.A pre-proposal meeting will be held 3rd November, 2026 at NITA-U Head Office, Palm Courts, Plot 7A, Rotary Avenue at 1100 Hours East Africa Time with an Online Virtual Meeting .A link will be shared with all registered proposers prior to the date of the meeting. The proposers who wish to attend the meeting shall register and submit their official email addresses not later than one (1) day to the date of the meeting to jacqueline.musimenta@nita.go.ug.

6.The request for proposal document in English may be purchased by interested eligible Proposers upon the submission of a written application to the address below and upon payment of a nonrefundable fee of Ugx.200,000 (Two Hundred Thousand Uganda Shillings Only) or equivalent in a freely convertible currency. The method of payment will be the Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) Bank account number: 006550058000001, Customer name: National Information Technology Authority, Uganda (NITA-U), Account title: NITA-U Local Revenue Expenditure Account, Bank Name: Bank of Uganda Swift Code: UGBAUGKA. A PDF bidding document shall be sent to the potential bidder electronically upon receipt of confirmation of payment.

7.Proposals must be delivered to the address below on or before 30th November, 2026 at 1100 Hours East Africa Time Electronic procurement will not be permitted. Late Proposals will be rejected. Proposals will be publicly opened in the presence of the Proposers’ designated representatives and anyone who chooses to attend, at the address below on 1st Floor Boardroom, 1105 Hours East Africa Time 30th November, 2026.  All envelopes marked “FINANCIAL PART” shall remain unopened and will be held in safe custody of the Purchaser until the second public Proposals opening.

 8.Proposals must be accompanied by a Proposal Security of ;

 UGX 120,000,000/= (Uganda Shillings, One Hundred and Twenty Million) or an equivalent amount in a freely convertible currency.

 

The Proposal Security shall be valid in accordance with Section II-Proposal Data Sheet (PDS); ITP 20.1

9.Attention is drawn to the Procurement Regulations requiring the Borrower to disclose information on the successful proposer’s beneficial ownership, as part of the Contract Award Notice, using the Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Form as included in the proposal document.

10.The address referred to above is:

    The Procurement Specialist

    National Information Technology Authority-Uganda

    Plot 7A, Palm Courts, Rotary Avenue,1st Floor Room 1

    Kampala-Uganda
